**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One reference-guided sword-and-water loop, 912 × 784 MP4 with 12 decoded frames and 1.46 seconds container duration, without audio. The full prompt asks for a downloadable GIF; X serves the attachment as MP4, so this is not presented as the original GIF. All 12 frames were visually inspected, not watched in real-time playback. The reference remains link-only after the historical 403 and browser-save timeout; it was not requested or restored. The quoted heartbeat comparison is a separate work.
